Living Well / Free resources

AI literacy & thoughtful use

A useful way in

Choose one place to begin.

Understand the tools well enough to ask useful questions, check an answer, and decide when a simpler approach is sufficient.

Learning about AI need not mean following every product announcement. A useful foundation is to understand what a system is being asked to do, what information it receives, and what you will need to check. These resources offer accessible explanations and optional routes into deeper study.

Start with: How AI Works. Start with Introducing How AI Works at the top of the page, not the full lesson sequence.

Keep the context

Take what is useful, thoughtfully.

Independent educational material and vendor-authored tutorials serve different purposes. Read product examples as examples of the provider’s approach, not as neutral comparisons. Free lessons can demonstrate features that require payment elsewhere. Use fictional or non-sensitive material while learning, and keep responsibility for consequential decisions.

Selections are based on public source review, not a claim that Nolan uses every resource or belongs to the organizations listed.
